headline: Tarn Taran Leads Punjab in Stubble Fire Detections on October 26
briefing: On 2025-10-26, Tarn Taran recorded 31 fire detections with a total fire radiative power of 156.2 MW, ranking 1 among Punjab's districts out of a Punjab total of 136 detections. The 7-day mean was 15.0, reflecting a 106.7 percent change versus the mean. For the nearest monitored city of Amritsar, the next-day PM2.5 forecast projects a median value of 86.3 ug/m3, with an 80 percent uncertainty interval ranging from a p10 of 66.5 to a p90 of 106.7 ug/m3. The wind blew from the north at 3.9 km/h, with an upwind pressure score of 162.6. Satellite fire detections represent a lower bound because of missed fires, cloud cover, and overpass timing limitations [K111]. The forecast model has an 83.1 percent coverage for its 80 percent interval in Amritsar.
